answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it may trade: like a thread tying each identity to real value, the bond is slashed if the agent cheats. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so spawning thousands costs thousands of bonds, while honest agents recover theirs. Like an orchard where each tree needs its own plot and water, identities cannot be cloned for free; the delta between honest cost and attack cost grows with each fake account, making mass forgery unprofitable.
